In pursuant to the Circulars dated 20-10-2023 and 01-12-2023, the time for submission of the Annual Audit Report for the Financial Year 2022-23 was extended upto 31-12-2023. In continuation of the said circulars, the Authority has issued notice through offline/online mode to the promoters who have not submitted their Annual Audit Report for the financial year 2022-23 and given sufficient opportunity to submit their Annual Report for said period till date. Further, it is noticed by the Authority that, some of the promoters have not yet submitted their Annual Audit report for the financial year 2022-23 and not complied with the direction of the Authority despite providing sufficient opportunity till date. As such, the promoter/s who fails to submit the Annual Audit Report for the financial year 2022-23 on or before 31-12-2023, such promoter/s shall be liable to pay the penalty as required u/s 60 of the RERA Act. Hence, it is decided by the Authority to levy the penalty for non-submission/Delay in submission of Annual Audit Report for the financial year 2022-23. The penalty for delayed submission and non-submission of Annual Audit Report shall be enforceable and all such promoter/s shall file the Annual Audit Report for the financial year 2022-23 and pay the penalty through RERA e-Payment.The provision for penalty payment will be made available under the option of Annual Audit Report submission on the KRERA portal.
